heading: About the Rock Warblers

intro.tail: at Adventure Off Road Park — a Rock Warblers crawl on the Tennessee ridge with gated stages, real terrain, and a campfire night run to close it out.

items.label: Format
items.text: Three numbered stages, time-run. Gate touches, rolls, and driver assists cost you. Winching is free.

items.label: Mandatory skills
items.text: Water, a grade pull, and a taco-stand inside every stage.

items.label: Trail buddies
items.text: Required. Walk, mark, swap. Penalty winch travels with whoever isn’t carrying one.

items.label: Rigs
items.text: 1/10 electric scale. 1.9″ and 1.55″ wheel classes. No dig, no rear steer. Five scale accessories minimum.

items.label: Night crawl
items.text: Lights on after dusk. Leaves the pavilion, finishes at the fire.

items.label: The park
items.text: Adventure Off Road Park & Nature Center, South Pittsburg, TN. Six hundred acres of private ridge. Pavilion is base camp: registration, driver meeting, awards, and the fire pit. Camping on-site, first come.

items.label: The map
items.text: On-day reference built from real terrain data and our own ride evidence. Use it in staging, at the pavilion, and walking a stage. Every line traces back to where it came from.

items.label: The crew
items.text: Rock Warblers. We build the rigs, walk the stages, throw the days. Find us at the pavilion or out walking a stage.

note: Built by Rock Warblers, for Rock Warblers. See you at the pavilion.
